title: AB81 (2023 Regular): Revises provisions governing firearms. (BDR 15-117)

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Nevada) (gun-policy Stage 5, Nevada); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Nevada text (As introduced, official copy, https://archive.leg.state.nv.us/Session/82nd2023/Bills/AB/AB81.pdf; sha256 d7c3f3d6080f4302e5dc2d037cf6bce5b61a749540c37ee19fb9a08a86bccea5)
provenance.note: As-filed version (prefiled January 30, 2023); no passage vote on record. Same change as the 2021 bill AB 80; it also corrects a federal-law citation in NRS 202.3653 (Section 2), and strikes and renumbers other words of NRS 202.265.

operative_text:
Section 1 (NRS 202.265): A handgun on the property of the Nevada System of Higher Education or a private or public school or child care facility by a person who holds a permit to carry a concealed firearm issued pursuant to the provisions of NRS 202.3653 to 202.369, inclusive, if the handgun remains out of common observation and is: (1) Inside a motor vehicle, other than a school bus, that is: (I) Occupied; or (II) Unoccupied and locked; or (2) Stored in a locked container that is affixed securely to a motor vehicle, other than a school bus.
Section 3 (NRS 202.3673): (2) Possesses a handgun in accordance with the provisions of paragraph (b) of subsection 3 of NRS 202.265.
